item.title: Bumper Harvest in Chu and Talas Lifts Grain and Potato Output Sharply
item.description: The ISEZ has brought in about 1.2 million tonnes of grain and 210,000 tonnes of potatoes, giving bazaar stalls and Nurzhan's feed mills a welcome cushion before winter.

item.title: Sary-Bulak Antimony Works and Chatkal Smelter Set for Phased Reopening
item.description: Lieutenant Governor Aidar Maksat told workers in Sary-Bulak that idled lines will restart in stages, with hiring from Lower Naryn and Chu.

item.title: Toktogul Upgrade Lifts Capacity to 1,440 MW, Strengthening Irad's Power Exports
item.description: The refitted Toktogul generating hall now delivers 240 MW more than its former 1,200 MW rating, and officials say the gain will move through the ISEZ switchyard under the Naryn Protocol.

item.title: Kazakh Flaxseed Exports Hit Record, Putting Irad's Trucking Corridors in Demand
item.description: Neighbouring Kazakhstan's near-1.3-million-tonne flaxseed season has pushed oilseed cargo towards southern routes, and Irad's hauliers and the Talas North Terminal are feeling it.

item.title: Kara-Khanid Coins Found at Rabat-i-Safed
item.description: Talas State University archaeologists have recovered 10th- and 11th-century coins, a cauldron fragment and storage jars at the Silk Road caravanserai.

item.title: National Komuz Competition to Honour Aigul Choro kyzy
item.description: Players of all ages are invited to Talas for an open competition marking 90 years since the birth of the ethnomusicologist who recorded Irad's music on the summer pastures.

item.title: Lieutenant Governor Opens Solar-Powered School in Nurzhan
item.description: The Navbahor district school is one of twelve opened this year, with eighteen more schools and kindergartens due before the end of December.

item.title: Tremor Felt Across the Fergana Rim; No Damage Reported
item.description: A magnitude 4.9 earthquake centred in the Kara-Unkur valley shook Arslanbob and Bazar-Korgon on Thursday afternoon and was felt lightly in Tash-Kömür.

item.title: Bank of Irad Warns Public Against Unregulated 'Tulparcoin'
item.description: The currency board reminds citizens that only the som and the US dollar are legal tender, as officials pledge to protect savings from speculation.

item.title: Akyel Colt Fetches Record $1 Million at Talas Autumn Sale
item.description: A two-year-old golden Akyel set a new national price at the Akyel Syndicate's autumn sale, as buyers from five countries crowded the State Hippodrome.

item.title: Talas Hosts International Film Festival
item.description: The Irad Film Society's biennial festival opens with films from more than five countries and an anniversary screening of a restored Iradi Western.

item.title: Irad's GDP Growth Exceeds Expectations
item.description: Official figures show the ISEZ economy grew 1.5% last year, ahead of forecasts, on beef exports and refinery output.

item.title: Irad and Uzbekistan Strengthen Bilateral Relations
item.description: Talas and Tashkent sign a trade and border-coordination memorandum, the first since the 2018 rangeland clashes.
